The crawl reached the 10-page cap, returning **8 unique pages** after removing URL variants. Raw content: [crawl results](.firecrawl/features-crawl.json).

- [Scrape](https://docs.firecrawl.dev/features/scrape): Converts individual URLs, including dynamic pages, into Markdown, structured data, HTML, or screenshots.
- [Crawl](https://docs.firecrawl.dev/features/crawl): Recursively discovers and extracts website pages with path filters, depth controls, and asynchronous results.
- [JSON mode](https://docs.firecrawl.dev/features/llm-extract): Extracts structured fields from one webpage using a prompt or JSON schema.
- [Agent](https://docs.firecrawl.dev/features/agent): Autonomously searches and navigates websites to gather data from a natural-language request.
- [Threat Protection](https://docs.firecrawl.dev/features/threat-protection): Enforces organization-wide policies that block risky URLs across Firecrawl endpoints.
- [PII Redaction](https://docs.firecrawl.dev/features/pii-redaction): Removes or masks personal information in returned Markdown before downstream use.
- [Ask](https://docs.firecrawl.dev/features/ask): Provides API-based troubleshooting and documentation answers for Firecrawl integrations.
- [SSO and SCIM](https://docs.firecrawl.dev/features/sso): Configures enterprise identity-provider sign-in and automatic user and group provisioning.
